HTML_Profile (object)
HTML profile with configurable options
Properties (* = required):
name
type(s)
default
allowed values
description
class*
string
“HTML_Profile”
contentDetectionEnabled
boolean
false
true, false
Scans initial HTTP payload to look for HTML signatures and enables HTML profile if HTML-like patterns are detected
contentSelection
array
“text/html”
Matches content-type from response header against a list of the content-types and enables HTML profile if a match is found
label
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22#&*<>?x5b-x5d`x7f]*$”
Optional friendly name for this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding a few likely to cause trouble with string searching, JS, TCL, or HTML
remark
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22x5cx7f]*$”
Arbitrary (brief) text pertaining to this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding only control characters, double-quote, and backslash.  This is permissive enough that you should worry about XSS attacks
rules
array
HTML Rules followed by the profile
